subject: Request: short pilot — temporary PO exception & onboarding docs
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Miller <jmiller@polarisflow.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-15T14:05:00Z
Subject: Quick: trial onboarding and PO requirement

Hi Jordan —

Great to meet you on the call earlier. We're excited to get PolarisFlow onto Redwood for the two-week integration pilot. A couple quick asks to get the procurement team unblocked:

- Is PolarisFlow able to accept a single invoice after the pilot (no PO) for engagements under $3,000?
- If not, what paperwork would you need so we can request a temporary exception from our procurement team?

We're aiming for a lightweight path: completed onboarding form + one invoice to billing@redwood.com. If procurement needs more, happy to share our short risk assessment and PII handling notes.

Can you point me to the right contact and any form you need filled out? If procurement prefers a PO, please let me know timing — we may need a temporary exception to avoid delaying the pilot start.

Thanks —
Aditya Rao
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0182

[Attachment: Redwood_Onboarding_Form_Polaris.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Jordan Miller <jmiller@polarisflow.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-15T15:12:00Z
Subject: Re: Quick: trial onboarding and PO requirement

Hi Aditya —

Thanks for the note — happy to run the pilot. Our procurement team requires either a PO or a signed exception memo for any vendor charge, but there is a light-weight path for trials under $5k.

What we need from your side:
- Completed vendor onboarding form (please include billing address and W9/VA equivalent)
- Brief justification for no-PO (who signs off internally and why)
- Expected invoice amount and billing email

Putting you in touch with procurement: procure@polarisflow.com — they prefer the completed form and a short internal approval note. If you can send those today we can fast-track the exception.

Regards,
Jordan Miller
Head of Product Partnerships, PolarisFlow
jmiller@polarisflow.com

Jordan / procurement team —

Looping in our procurement lead, Laura Bennett, and finance ops (Sean). Attached are the completed onboarding form and a short pilot risk assessment. Quick summary:

- Pilot scope: integration sandbox + up to 750 inference credits; expected invoice: $2,250
- Request: temporary no-PO path for this single pilot invoice only; internal approver: VP Product (Aditya Rao) — fingered below
- Duration: one invoice, to be paid within standard 30 days after pilot invoice issuance

Attachments:
- Redwood_Onboarding_Form_Polaris.pdf
- Pilot_Risk_Assessment.xlsx

Please confirm whether PolarisFlow can accept the invoice without a PO for this pilot and whether any additional sign-off is needed. Happy to sign an exception memo if required.

Thanks,
Aditya

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>

Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-16T16:30:00Z
Subject: RE: Fwd: Quick: trial onboarding and PO requirement — onboarding package attached

Jordan / Procurement —

Thanks for the review. I've reviewed the onboarding form and the attached risk assessment. Finance is comfortable approving a single-invoice exception for this pilot under the following conditions:

1) Invoice must be <= $3,000 and reference Redwood SOW #7809
2) PolarisFlow signs the attached short exception memo (I have attached a template) and returns it with the invoice
3) Invoice sent to billing@redwood.com with remit details matching the onboarding form
4) Exception valid for 90 days from today (2026-11-16) and limited to this one pilot engagement

If procurement at PolarisFlow agrees, Laura Bennett (Procurement Lead — Redwood) will issue a one-line approval memo on Redwood's side to close the loop.

Please confirm and attach the signed exception memo before invoicing.

Laura Bennett
Head of Procurement, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com
